name: T8 lead screw, 300 mm
summary: 8 mm trapezoidal screw with a 2 mm single-start lead, 300 mm long: one turn pushes the nut 2 mm.
description: A 300 mm T8 lead screw. The solid uses the outside envelope; the visual thread is schematic. Match the nut’s lead and number of starts.
source: 8 mm nominal diameter and 2 mm lead are the trade dimensions of the common T8 single-start screw (pitch 2 mm, one start, so one turn advances the nut 2 mm); the same 8 mm shaft is also sold with 4 mm and 8 mm leads for two- and four-start threads, so the lead is a variant, not a fact about the shaft, and this entry models the 2 mm single-start version. 'T8' is a trade designation for an 8 mm trapezoidal (Acme-style) thread rather than a single drawing, and no official sheet for the whole family was consulted, so the entry is marked approximate: the diameter and length of the drawn solid are exact as written, but the thread form, pitch tolerance and end machining are not modelled. 300 mm is a common stock length, not a standard - makers cut any length to order - and the thread shown in the view is decoration only.
